evidence_items.locator: Appended GPT-4 System Card, section 1, Introduction
evidence_items.explanation: The system card presents the broad risk categories as continuing problems requiring research and mitigation, not completed solutions. It also reports safety improvements and limited dangerous capabilities, which qualify the criticism without establishing elimination of those risks.

evidence_items.locator: Technical report, section 2, Scope and Limitations of this Technical Report
evidence_items.explanation: The report disclosed a training method, alongside the Transformer model family and next-token training objective. It withheld model size, detailed architecture, compute and dataset construction, supporting a criticism of limited transparency but contradicting a literal claim of no disclosure.

unresolved_gaps: The wording does not specify an exhaustive list of harms or a practical standard for declaring each solved.
The record supports unresolved broad risks, not a proof that every possible individual harmful behavior remained unpreventable.
